plugin.name: BioCyc Integration
plugin.description: Licensed, read-only integration with the BioCyc web services (SRI International): organism database list and KB versions, pathway/genome objects in ptools-xml (genes, proteins, reactions, pathways, compounds), the documented Pathway Tools API functions (e.g. genes-of-pathway, pathways-of-gene, reactions-of-compound), name search and foreign-ID mapping. Requires a BioCyc account (BIOCYC_EMAIL, BIOCYC_PASSWORD) with a subscription covering the queried databases; reports not_configured without it.

content.summary: Pathways, reactions, genes and compounds from BioCyc (BioCyc account required).

plugin.name: COSMIC Integration
plugin.description: Read-only integration with COSMIC (Catalogue Of Somatic Mutations In Cancer, cancer.sanger.ac.uk), a licensed cancer-genomics resource curated by the Wellcome Sanger Institute. COSMIC has no public REST query API; the only officially documented programmatic mechanism is its authenticated scripted-download service. This connector uses that mechanism to expose two small, bounded, release-scoped reference products -- the Cancer Gene Census (gene-level cancer association: tier, role in cancer, mutation types, tumour types) and the tissue/histology classification vocabulary -- plus health and release/dataset metadata. Requires a COSMIC account (free academic registration, or a commercial license via QIAGEN) configured as COSMIC_EMAIL/COSMIC_PASSWORD for every action except get_release_info/list_datasets. Gene/mutation-level search, tumour-sample search, and publication search are explicitly NOT implemented -- COSMIC's own robots.txt disallows every page that would carry that data, and the only alternative (downloading COSMIC's full licensed bulk mutation export) is out of scope; see README.md's 'Supported vs. Unsupported Capabilities' section.

content.summary: Cancer Gene Census and tissue/histology classification lookup from COSMIC's licensed scripted-download service.

plugin.name: DrugBank Integration
plugin.description: Licensed, read-only integration with DrugBank's Clinical API (api.drugbank.com) -- drug name/synonym/brand-name search, product lookup by NDC/DPD/EMA identifiers, drug-drug interaction checks, and DrugBank category/ATC classification data, for use in OmniBioAI agents and pharmacology/drug-repurposing workflows. Requires a negotiated commercial DrugBank license and a configured DRUGBANK_API_KEY for every action except drugbank.get_release_info. This connector implements only the four endpoints confirmed during implementation (drug_names, products, ddi, categories); target/enzyme/transporter/carrier/pathway/mechanism-of-action/pharmacokinetics/toxicity/full-chemistry tools are exposed for agent discovery but return a structured 'not yet documented' error rather than a fabricated schema -- see README.md's Documentation Coverage section.

content.summary: Drug search, drug-drug interactions, and classification data from DrugBank's licensed Clinical API.
